name: libvxl Map Storage and Access
definition: A sparse voxel map storage system for 'Ace of Spades' (Voxel Space) maps, using a compressed internal format derived from .vxl files. It supports floating block detection and top-layer block retrieval.
summary: Libvxl Map Storage and Access is a sparse voxel system for Ace of Spades maps that maintains an in-memory chunked structure for direct access rather than just serialization.
